verdict.rationale: The skill ships as plain, readable files: single `SKILL.md` files that can be pasted into a chat, and folders that can be copied by hand into `.claude/skills/`. Its README also discloses its scripts as six standard-library Python files that do not touch the network, and names script paths like `replica-design/contrast.py`. This lets a lead inspect the content, but the skill offers no dedicated way to list everything before installing or to audit installed files, so most of the review falls to the user manually reading the repo. Missing for 10: an explicit file manifest or pre-install content listing, documentation of exactly what the plugin install writes to disk, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the script and network claims hold.
